🎬 The Black Phone (2021)

The Black Phone follows Finney Blake, a shy 13-year-old boy living in a Colorado suburb during the late 1970s, where a mysterious masked kidnapper known as The Grabber has been terrorizing the community. When Finney becomes his latest victim, he finds himself trapped inside a soundproof basement with seemingly no way to escape. However, a disconnected black telephone hanging on the wall begins ringing, allowing Finney to communicate with the spirits of the killer’s previous victims. Through their mysterious guidance, he discovers clues that could help him survive. Meanwhile, his younger sister Gwen experiences disturbing visions that may reveal his location. As time runs out, Finney must find the courage to confront his captor. Starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames, The Black Phone combines supernatural horror, psychological suspense, and emotional storytelling while exploring courage, survival, family, and resilience.

🎭 Genre: Horror • Mystery • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 43m • R

🎥 Director: Scott Derrickson

✍️ Writers: Scott Derrickson & C. Robert Cargill, based on the short story by Joe Hill

📺 Where to Watch: Check Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Black Phone is a 2021 American supernatural horror film directed by Scott Derrickson from a screenplay he wrote with C. Robert Cargill, based on the 2004 short story by Joe Hill. It is the first installment in the Black Phone franchise. It stars Mason Thames as Finney, a teenage boy abducted by a serial child killer known colloquially as the Grabber (Ethan Hawke). When Finney encounters a mystical black rotary phone in captivity, he uses it to plot his escape by communicating with the ghosts of the Grabber's slain victims.
